tools.name: admin-apps-copy-auth
tools.description: Copy the COMPLETE authentication (user secrets + OAuth tokens with refresh) from one app instance to another of the same app type — cross-workspace. Full replace on the target (set semantics). Whose credential is copied: the explicit userId when given, else the owner of the source app's workspace. The response lists only the copied field names and masks — values are NEVER exposed. OAuth caveat: both instances share the same tokens afterwards; if the provider rotates refresh tokens, one instance can invalidate the other. Super admin only.

sourceAppId.description: App instance to copy the credentials FROM (must already be connected)

targetAppId.description: App instance to copy the credentials TO (same mcaId as the source)

userId.description: Optional: whose credential to copy. Default: the owner of the source app's workspace (the user who typically connected it).

sourceWorkspaceId.description: Required: the workspace the source app lives in — cross-workspace tools always name their workspaces (Teros infra is sharded by workspaceId)

targetWorkspaceId.description: Required: the workspace the target app lives in — cross-workspace tools always name their workspaces (Teros infra is sharded by workspaceId)

tools.name: admin-users-grant-access

userId.description: User ID to grant access to (e.g. user_xxx). Find it in the admin panel Users window.

tools.name: admin-users-update-role

userId.description: User ID to update (e.g. user_xxx). Find it in the admin panel Users window.

tools.name: admin-catalog-list
tools.description: List available MCAs in the catalog as lightweight summaries (id, name, description, category, tool count, keywords, availability). Does NOT return tool schemas — use admin-catalog-get for the full detail of one app. Supports free-text search across names, descriptions, keywords and tool names, and category filtering. Super admin only.

search.description: Free-text search (case-insensitive substring) across MCA id, name, description, tagline, category, keywords and tool names (optional).

includeHidden.description: Include hidden MCAs in the results (default false).

tools.name: admin-catalog-get
tools.description: Get the full catalog detail of a single MCA (app): complete description, auth configuration, secrets requirements, and the full tool list with their schemas. Use admin-catalog-list first to find the mcaId. Super admin only.

tools.name: admin-active-sessions
tools.description: List active WebSocket connections in real time: total connections, unique users, and per-session detail (userName, userEmail, connectedAt, lastActivityAt, idleSeconds, connectionDurationSeconds). Admin only.

tools.name: admin-refresh-clients
tools.description: Restart all connected browsers: broadcast a refresh signal to every connected client (all users, all devices) so they reload to the latest deployed version. Clients reload with random staggered delay (default 0-30s jitter) to avoid overloading the backend. Optional params: userId (string, refresh only that user's sessions), reason (string, e.g. "deploy" — shown in client logs), maxDelayMs (number, stagger window, default 30000, max 300000). Returns how many sessions received the signal (sent, totalConnections, uniqueUsers). Admin only.

userId.description: Optional: refresh only this user's sessions (all their devices). Omit to refresh everyone.

reason.description: Why the refresh is happening (e.g. "deploy", "admin"). Defaults to "admin".

maxDelayMs.description: Stagger window in ms for the client-side jittered reload. Default 30000 (0-30s). Max 300000.

tools.description: List most expensive conversations by cost. Super admin only.

tools.name: admin-usage-timeline
tools.description: Get usage timeline (daily/weekly aggregates). Super admin only.

startDate.description: Start date (ISO 8601). If omitted, returns all available data from the earliest rollup.

endDate.description: End date (ISO 8601). If omitted, no upper bound.

tools.name: admin-usage-sessions
tools.description: List agent usage sessions (paginated, newest first). Each session represents one LLM turn. Accepts filters (userId, agentId, workspaceId, provider, triggerKind, statuses) and pagination (limit, skip). Use format="otel" for OpenTelemetry-style output. Super admin only.

from.description: Start of the time window (ISO 8601 date). Required.

to.description: End of the time window (ISO 8601 date). Required.

skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

tools.name: admin-usage-session-detail
tools.description: Get the full detail and chronological trace of a single agent usage session: the session record, its LLM calls, tool executions, message text, thumbs feedback, and direct sub-agents. Requires a sessionUsageId. Super admin only (conversation text is super-admin-only).

sessionUsageId.description: The session usage ID of the session to inspect. Required.

tools.name: admin-model-health
tools.description: Get per-model LLM health metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency + TTFT, error rate by kind, success rate, throughput) grouped by actual upstream provider × model. Accepts optional filters (userId, agentId, workspaceId, provider) and a time range (from/to as ISO dates). Super admin only.

from.description: Start of the time window (ISO 8601 date, e.g. 2026-09-14T00:00:00Z). Required.

to.description: End of the time window (ISO 8601 date, e.g. 2026-09-15T00:00:00Z). Required.

provider.description: Filter by logical provider name (optional, e.g. "fireworks", "openai").

timeZone.description: Timezone label echoed in the response for client-side rendering (default "UTC").

tools.name: admin-model-health-timeseries
tools.description: Get per-hour health snapshots (p50/p95/p99 latency + TTFT, error rate, success rate, throughput) grouped by actual upstream provider × model, as a time series. Same scope as admin-model-health but returns one entry per time bucket instead of a merged figure. Accepts optional filters and groupBy (hour/day/week). Super admin only.

from.description: Start of the time window (ISO 8601 date). Required.

to.description: End of the time window (ISO 8601 date). Required.

timeZone.description: Timezone label echoed in the response (default "UTC").

tools.name: admin-upstream-errors
tools.description: Get the most recent upstream provider errors (rate_limited, overloaded, server_error, spend_gate, auth_error, model_unavailable). Returns the error kind, sub-reason, and PII-scrubbed upstream message per session. Accepts optional filters (userId, agentId, workspaceId, provider) and a time range (from/to). Super admin only.

from.description: Start of the time window (ISO 8601 date). Required.

to.description: End of the time window (ISO 8601 date). Required.

tools.name: admin-in-flight
tools.description: Get a live snapshot of LLM streams currently in flight, per real upstream provider. Reads from the in-memory process gauge (not the database), so it is a point-in-time reading of this backend instance. Returns per-upstream counts, total, and a capturedAt timestamp. Super admin only.

tools.name: admin-provider-status
tools.description: Get a complete LLM provider health overview in a single call. Composes three backend actions (model-health, upstream-errors, in-flight) and returns: per-provider×model health metrics with classified status (healthy/degraded/down), recent upstream errors, live in-flight stream counts, and an overall platform verdict (green/yellow/red) with context. Parameters: periodHours (default 24), optional provider/model filters. Degrades gracefully — if one backend action fails, returns the rest with partial: true. Super admin only.

periodHours.description: Time window in hours for health metrics and error retrieval (default 24).

provider.description: Filter by logical provider name (optional, e.g. "fireworks", "openai").

model.description: Filter by model ID (optional, applied client-side on results).
